title: A Brand New Homepage
summary: dungeon.training has a brand new homepage: the whole train at a glance, live, from the books written to who is streaming right now.
description:
dungeon.training has a brand new homepage. Scroll down and the whole train is there at a glance, and it's all live:

- How many riders, books, shared carriages and photos the community has made
- The Live Feed, with the Live Eye chat beside the stream whenever someone is on air
- The latest updates, stacked up to flip through
- Everyone who has helped build the train, wearing their own skin
- What riders think, straight from the in-game survey

[https://dungeon.training/](https://dungeon.training/)
